mechanism.claim: At each regular BTC funding boundary, an upper-tail completed final-hour price move whose direction agrees with the completed premium-index pressure identifies leverage-driven pre-settlement demand. In a high realized-variation regime, fade that pressure for six hours after settlement.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of the completed pre-boundary one-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSAR uses a six-hour shock followed by a two-hour opposing volume-backed move; PPCSR uses a premium zero crossing; HVEFR uses the actual funding-rate residual; funding-price concordance candidates use the funding value itself. HVPFPR uses no funding value: its primary object is directional agreement between the completed final-hour BTC move and mean premium pressure immediately before the fixed funding boundary. No event set or control is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed prior-24-hour BTC variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, while the pre-boundary displacement must rank in its upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: only sparse price-premium pressure states at settlement boundaries survive, rather than every fixed funding clock

features.pre_boundary_window: 60 exact completed one-minute rows [decision-1h,decision) for BTCUSDT perpetual and BTCUSDT premium index
features.btc_return: log(last BTC close/first BTC open), strict nonzero
features.premium_pressure: arithmetic mean of 60 finite premium-index closes, strict nonzero
features.return_tail_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(btc_return) over at most 270 previous source-valid boundaries, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC one-minute log(close/open) returns over [decision-24h,decision))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 previous source-valid boundaries, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.source_valid: exact unique coherent finite positive BTC OHLC and finite coherent premium-index OHLC on both required grids; no imputation

clock.decision: exact regular funding boundary after all pre-boundary source minutes complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact realized funding cash only after novelty
clock.oi_rv20: not signal inputs; RV20 q90 only after all stages pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.funding_rate_values: sealed and not read during source support
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent pre-settlement price-premium pressure release mechanism

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no window, rank, alignment, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
